datasets.title: HOTOSM Antigua and Barbuda Schools
datasets.description: OpenStreetMap exports for use in GIS applications. This theme includes all OpenStreetMap features in this area matching: amenity IN ('kindergarten', 'school', 'college', 'university','language_school') OR office='educational_institution' Features may have these attributes: name, amenity, isced:level, capacity Geometry types: point, polygon This dataset is one of many OpenStreetMap exports on HDX. See the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team website for more information..
